title: claude-statusline config
description: Lives at ~/.claude/statusline-claude-statusline.config.json (or $STATUSLINE_CONFIG). Outside the plugin directory on purpose — a plugin update never touches it.

layout.description: minimal = 1 line (model/context/git). hardened = 2 lines, matches the original model/context/lines/git + rate-limits layout. power = adds a 3rd line with cost/session/PR/effort/thinking/cache-TTL, each shown only when the underlying field is present in that turn's payload.

asciiMode.description: true replaces block-bar characters (█░) and emoji (🌿⬡⚠) with plain ASCII (#-, git:/wt:/!), for terminals/fonts without Unicode or Nerd Font glyph support.

thresholds.description: Percentage thresholds shared by the context bar and both rate-limit bars: below warn = green, [warn,crit) = yellow, >= crit = red.

compactHint.description: When context% >= thresholds.crit, append a red '· /compact?' suffix to the context segment, in every layout.
